blogSeo.title: Blog
blogSeo.description: Articles in {{locales}}. Drafts save by themselves; published posts save when you press Save.
blogSeo.empty: No posts yet. Press “New post” to write the first one.
blogSeo.sideBySide: Side by side with the default language
blogSeo.loadError: Could not load. Check the connection and refresh.
blogSeo.fallbackNote: Languages without a translation show the {{locale}} version until their translation is complete; their old address then redirects permanently.
blogSeo.confirmDeleteText: The post, its translations and its slug history are removed. Links to it will stop working.

fields.title: Title
fields.slugFollowsTitle: Follows the title while the post is a draft. Type to set it by hand.
fields.slugRedirect: Changing it on a published post keeps the old address as a permanent redirect.
fields.excerptHint: One or two sentences shown in lists, feeds and search results.
fields.bodyPlaceholder: Write here. Use headings (H2/H3) for sections: they become the table of contents.
fields.coverAltHint: What the cover photo shows, for screen readers and image search.
fields.coverHint: Shown on cards and at the top of the post.
fields.coverWideHint: For the featured slot and wide screens. Falls back to the cover.
fields.author: Author
fields.name: Name

autosave.leave: There are unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.past: Pick a time in the future.

preview.title: Preview
preview.noStorefront: Set the plugin option storefrontUrl to get full links.
preview.rotateHint: The old preview link stops working.

products.relatedHint: Shown under the post. Up to 12.

upload.notImage: That file is not an image.

editor.help: Paste a link or a YouTube address directly into the text.
editor.caption: Caption
editor.youtubeBad: That is not a YouTube link.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Group posts. Each language gets its own name and address.
categories.confirmDeleteText: {{count}} posts keep their text but lose this category.

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: People or organisations shown as the writer. Job title and bio per language.
authors.sameAsHint: One link per line: LinkedIn, Instagram, Wikipedia… used in structured data.
authors.confirmDeleteText: {{count}} posts keep their text but lose this author.

settings.title: Blog settings
settings.description: Languages, the default language and what to show when a translation is missing.
settings.localesHelp: Order here is the order of tabs and of hreflang links. Disabled languages keep their text but are hidden from the store.
settings.addLocaleHint: BCP-47 code: en, de, pt-BR, ar…
settings.badCode: That is not a valid language code.
settings.duplicate: That language is already in the list.
settings.defaultLocaleHelp: Required for every post; other languages fall back to it.

fallbackMode.label: Show the default language with a note

fallbackHelp.default: Readers see the default-language text at that language's address.
fallbackHelp.label: Same, and the store can show “not yet translated”.
fallbackHelp.hide: The post appears only in languages that have a complete translation.

settings.routingHelp: Set in the plugin options (routing): base path, prefix per language, category and feed segments.

errors.incomplete: Missing fields: fill in the title, excerpt and text first.
errors.slug_taken: That address is already used by another post.
errors.locked: This setting is fixed in the plugin options.
